operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
it is hereby ordered that, in the event that  
the Department of Veterans Affairs is requested by the Department of Defense  
to furnish care and services to members of the United States Armed Forces on  
active duty in Operation Desert Storm, the Secretary of Veterans Affairs may,  
pursuant to this order, enter into contracts with private facilities for the  
provision of hospital care and medical services for veterans to the fullest  
extent authorized by section 501lA(b)(l)-(2) of title 38 of the United States  
Code.
